text:
hey alireza2297 understanding how to find the important FLs is the key to know where price is going by engulfing them and they give you the most important edges for trading there are lots of FTRs in the chart that if you want to follow the definitions, that make it confusing where price really wanna reverse or by engulfing where is the next aim, coz there are lots of SRs in the chart and lots of highs and lows RTM wants to teach us how to read the market, not only looking for the patterns and shapes by investigating where price reversed in the past and where price was hold, you can really be close to the concept of FL and when the aha moment catches you, you will understand that price moves from FL to FL and that will be a turning point in your trading style by the way IF's journal is a master piece and you can find your answers about FLs there

Regards omidFxt
